narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.note: The evangelist; grave and intimate, the night of the Last Supper.

jesus.name: Jesus
jesus.note: The Lord at the Last Supper: tender, unhurried farewell to his own; solemn in the priestly prayer.

thomas.name: Thomas
thomas.note: Apostle; blunt and puzzled, wants plain directions.

philip.name: Philip
philip.note: Apostle; earnest and simple, asks to be shown the Father.

jude.name: Judas (not the Iscariot)
jude.note: The apostle Jude Thaddeus; a sincere, wondering question.

1.t: Let not your heart be troubled. You believe in God: believe also in me.

2.t: In my Father's house there are many mansions. If not, I would have told you: because I go to prepare a place for you.

3.t: And if I shall go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will take you to myself: that where I am, you also may be.

4.t: And whither I go you know: and the way you know.

5.t: Lord, we know not whither thou goest. And how can we know the way?

6.t: I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No man cometh to the Father, but by me.

7.t: If you had known me, you would without doubt have known my Father also: and from henceforth you shall know him. And you have seen him.

8.t: Lord, shew us the Father; and it is enough for us.

9.t: Have I been so long a time with you and have you not known me? Philip, he that seeth me seeth the Father also. How sayest thou: Shew us the Father?

10.t: Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father in me? The words that I speak to you, I speak not of myself. But the Father who abideth in me, he doth the works.

11.t: Believe you not that I am in the Father and the Father in me?

12.t: Otherwise believe for the very works' sake. Amen, amen, I say to you, he that believeth in me, the works that I do, he also shall do: and greater than these shall he do.

13.t: Because I go to the Father: and whatsoever you shall ask the Father in my name, that will I do: that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

14.t: If you shall ask me any thing in my name, that I will do.

15.t: If you love me, keep my commandments.

16.t: And I will ask the Father: and he shall give you another Paraclete, that he may abide with you for ever:

17.t: The spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, nor knoweth him. But you shall know him; because he shall abide with you and shall be in you.

18.t: I will not leave you orphans: I will come to you.

19.t: Yet a little while and the world seeth me no more. But you see me: because I live, and you shall live.

20.t: In that day you shall know that I am in my Father: and you in me, and I in you.

21.t: He that hath my commandments and keepeth them; he it is that loveth me. And he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father: and I will love him and will manifest myself to him.

22.t: Judas saith to him, not the Iscariot:
Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself to us, and not to the world?

23.t: Jesus answered and said to him:
If any one love me, he will keep my word. And my Father will love him and we will come to him and will make our abode with him.

24.t: He that loveth me not keepeth not my words. And the word which you have heard is not mine; but the Father's who sent me.

25.t: These things have I spoken to you, abiding with you.

26.t: But the Paraclete, the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things and bring all things to your mind, whatsoever I shall have said to you.

27.t: Peace I leave with you: my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, do I give unto you. Let not your heart be troubled: nor let it be afraid.

28.t: You have heard that I said to you: I go away, and I come unto you. If you loved me you would indeed be glad, because I go to the Father: for the Father is greater than I.

29.t: And now I have told you before it come to pass: that when it shall come to pass, you may believe.

30.t: I will not now speak many things with you. For the prince of this world: cometh: and in me he hath not any thing.

31.t: But that the world may know that I love the Father: and as the Father hath given me commandments, so do I. Arise, let us go hence.
